redBeforeFix: vitest -t 1686 against the #1691 base (96862833): 7 failed | 0 passed. 4x the parked xit/xtest/.skip.each body ran into 'real' (findings not []); 2x describe.skip/xdescribe bodies drew VAC findings; 1x checked 2 vs 1. Re-confirmed by restoring only static-linter.ts and vacuity-scanner.ts to the base after the fix (7 failed), 7 passed with the fix.
assumptions: Human decision: all three findings in scope; F4 answer (a).

Every test inside a describe.skip(...) or xdescribe(...) call is skipped: exempt from VAC-001/VAC-002 and not counted as checked. The block extent is the balanced (...) of that call over string-blanked code, stepping over comments and string/template/regex literals; a call whose ) cannot be found marks nothing (tests stay scanned, the pre-#1686 behaviour) rather than skipping the rest of the file.

xit, xtest, it.skip.each and test.skip.each are recognised as declarations in the shared enumerator (enumerateTests) and marked skipped. The .each table is matched lazily, bounded to 2000 chars and never across ';'; a table longer than that is not recognised (falls back to the old behaviour).
Out of scope and unchanged: it.each / test.each (non-skip) are still not enumerated; describe.skip.each, context.skip, suite.skip and Python skip markers are not treated as skipped suites.
Because enumerateTests is shared, LINT-006 exempts the same forms and the test inventory now lists xit/xtest/.skip.each tests.
The VAC skip reason text changed from 'declared .skip: ...' to 'declared skipped (.skip, xit/xtest, or inside describe.skip/xdescribe): ...'; it still contains '.skip'.

Docs: SKILL.md VAC-002 reassignment bullet and the #1672 CHANGELOG entry now say 'a direct call of it abstains; a method call on it is still judged'; SKILL.md and the #1669 CHANGELOG entry name the exempt skip forms. No mirrored copy of canary-cassandra/SKILL.md exists in the repo and no sync script covers it.
Measured on canary's own ts/test: no change (5619 checked, 215 findings, 579 skipped before and after) -- the suite uses none of these forms outside string fixtures.
